revision_focus: Independent modern community attestations remove SRC-02-only dependence for the Nessé/Nisé and Tſchiper/Chipér candidates.

historical_model_unchanged.steffel: ameke is source-explicit participial; final ke often omitted in pronunciation; short -ame surfaces are attested
historical_model_unchanged.merrill: relevant historical chains contain participial -(a)me plus optional reduplicative -kV/-ke; Merrill is an analysis layer on Steffel, not a second historical witness

modern_independence_structure.compendio_1997: independent multivariety evidence for -kame/-kami/-name/-nami/-ame/-ami/-m color morphology
modern_independence_structure.caballero_2022: independent Choguita evidence for participial -ame/-kame, kotʃi and siˈríame
modern_independence_structure.sep_2010_balleza: independent bilingual community usage nise’ami/niseami aligned with ‘El pastorcito’
modern_independence_structure.sep_2010_guerrero: independent bilingual community usage chiperami in a line aligned with ‘parezco tablilla’

candidate_ranking_v4.main_open_problem: reconstruct additional k-material and morpheme ordering
historical root variants and added morphology
formal Nessé ~ Nisé correspondence and dialect geography
specific l~r correspondence and lexical continuity

candidate_ranking_v4.new_independent_evidence: SEP 2010 Guerrero community riddle with chiperami aligned contextually to ‘tablilla’
candidate_ranking_v4.main_open_problem: formal root correspondence and exact semantics/category in community usage
mapping multiple Steffel roots to modern seyó/siyó paradigms

important_new_inference: The research bottleneck has shifted. For the principal candidates, lack of independent modern evidence is no longer the dominant problem; the next decisive tests are historical-modern sound correspondences, stem morphology and dialect geography.
next_research_program: Build independent correspondence sets for historical e/é versus modern i/í to test Nessé ~ Nisé without circularity.
Build affricate/orthographic correspondence sets and root-family evidence for Tſchiper- ~ Chiper-.
Search community and grammatical corpora for additional niseami and chiperami tokens with geographic metadata.
Maintain source-independence metadata on every new token.
Do not reopen a blanket -ameke > -ami rule; treat the participial domain and additional morphology separately.
publication_level_claim_v4: After controlling documentary dependence and adding independent multivariety, grammatical and community evidence, the project now has several historical-modern families in which participial/derivational functions and lexical semantics recur outside the Hilton/SRC-02 line. This substantially strengthens the continuity hypothesis for an ame-centered participial domain while making phonological and stem-morphological reconstruction the principal unresolved task.
